auto.badge_tooltip: Chosen by the integration. Change the value to pin it.
auto.home_note_one: The integration chose {count} entity or list on its own, marked “Automatic” in each section. They follow new devices until you change them; whatever you change stays your choice.
auto.home_note_other: The integration chose {count} entities and lists on its own, marked “Automatic” in each section. They follow new devices until you change them; whatever you change stays your choice.
auto.takeover_list: This list was filled in by the integration, which keeps it up to date on its own (for example, when new devices appear in Home Assistant). If you change it, the whole list becomes yours and the integration stops updating it.
auto.takeover_field: This field was chosen by the integration, which keeps it up to date on its own (for example, if the entity disappears). If you change it, it becomes your choice and the integration stops updating it.
auto.reset_tooltip: Give this choice back to the integration
auto.reset_text_list: The integration will choose the {list} list on its own again and keep it up to date. Your current choice is lost and the change is saved right away.
auto.reset_text_field: The integration will choose this field on its own again and keep it up to date. Your current choice is lost and the change is saved right away.
auto.reset_failed: Home Assistant didn't respond. The choice is still yours.

home.title: Set up the screen
home.lead: What the screen shows and which entities it reads its data from. Meals, tasks and lists are edited on the screen itself.

status.unknown_text: Restart Home Assistant after updating the integration to see here whether the screen is connected.
status.none_text: The screen shows up here once it's connected to Home Assistant.
status.live_text: Saved changes show up on the screen within a few seconds.

family.title: Family
family.desc: People in the house, colours and personal calendars.
family.intro: Who lives in the house. The colour shows on their tasks and events.

calendars.title: Other calendars
calendars.desc: Holidays and calendars that don't belong to anyone.
calendars.intro: A holiday calendar is recognised by its name and is always red.

weather.title: Weather
weather.desc: Outdoor temperature and the header forecast.
weather.intro: What shows in the screen's header, next to the clock.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.desc: Light, climate, window and blinds for each area.
rooms.intro: One card per Home Assistant area, in the order they appear on the House page.

house.title: House
house.desc: Alarm, hot water, scenes, locks and cameras.
house.intro: Security, hot water and shortcuts on the House page.

energy.title: Energy
energy.desc: Solar, grid and battery flow, and consumers.
energy.intro: The sensors of the Energy card.

assistant.title: Voice assistant
assistant.intro: What the assistant is called on the screen. The integration takes these from the voice satellite's wake word.

lists.title: Lists
lists.desc: Which to-do lists show on the screen.
lists.intro: The lists on the Lists page and the Shopping card on Home.

vacuums.title: Vacuums
vacuums.desc: Robot vacuums and what the screen controls.
vacuums.intro: The Vacuums card on the House page and the controls for each robot.

cars.title: Cars
cars.desc: Electric and combustion cars, and when they're home.
cars.intro: The screen shows up to 2 cars, the ones at home, in the order of this list.

people.title: People
people.empty: No people set up: the screen shows nobody on tasks or events.
people.missing: Name missing: will be discarded on save
people.required: Required. Without a name, this item is discarded on save.
people.dropped_one: {count} person without a name was discarded
people.dropped_other: {count} people without a name were discarded

calendarEntityId.label: Personal calendar
calendarEntityId.help: New events "for" this person are created in this calendar.

todoEntityId.label: Personal to-do list
todoEntityId.help: The "my" reminders and tasks when the assistant recognises this person's voice.

speakerId.label: Voice identification
speakerId.help: The name this person's voice was enrolled under in the voice assistant. When it recognises them, the assistant uses their calendar and list.

personEntityId.label: Person in Home Assistant
personEntityId.help: This person's phone (with the Home Assistant app) receives the pages sent from the assistant. Empty: the Home Assistant person with the same name.

color.label: Colour
color.help: Shows on this person's tasks and events.

calendars.title: Calendars
calendars.hint: Calendars that don't belong to anyone, such as holidays or a household calendar.
calendars.empty: No extra calendars. The screen shows only the people's calendars.
calendars.missing: Calendar missing: will be discarded on save
calendars.required: Required. Without a calendar, this item is discarded on save.
calendars.dropped_one: {count} entry without a calendar was discarded
calendars.dropped_other: {count} entries without a calendar were discarded
calendars.owner_color: {name}'s calendar: always uses this person's colour. Change it in Family.

exteriorTempEntityId.label: Outdoor temperature
exteriorTempEntityId.help: The big number in the screen's header.

weatherStateEntityId.label: Weather entity
weatherStateEntityId.help: Provides the conditions, highs and lows, and the forecast.

sunEntityId.label: Sun
sunEntityId.help: Sunrise and sunset: in the forecast and for automatic dark mode.

warningEntityId.label: Weather warning
warningEntityId.help: E.g. your weather service's warning. Shows in the forecast.

name.label: Name
name.help: Shows at the top of the assistant on the screen.

wakePhrase.label: Wake word
wakePhrase.help: What you say to call it. Should match the voice satellite's.

weather_station.title: Weather station
weather_station.hint: The readings on the Outdoor card, on the House page. Empty: the reading doesn't show.

rooms.title: Home Assistant areas
rooms.hint: Areas and floors come from Home Assistant. Temperature and humidity are the area's own sensors in Home Assistant. The integration picks each area's light, air conditioning, window and blinds on its own (marked “Automatic”); whatever you change here stays your choice. An area with nothing (not even temperature or humidity sensors) doesn't show on the screen.
rooms.empty: No areas in Home Assistant. Create areas in Settings › Areas, labels & zones.
rooms.area_note: The name, floor and temperature and humidity sensors come from the "{name}" area in Home Assistant (Settings › Areas).

lightEntityId.label: Light
lightEntityId.help: The light button on the card and "Turn off all lights".

secondaryEntityId.label: Extra line
secondaryEntityId.help: One more state. A lock shows as locked/unlocked.

scenes.title: Scenes
scenes.missing: Scene or script missing: will be discarded on save
scenes.required: Required. Without a scene or script, this item is discarded on save.
scenes.dropped_one: {count} scene without a scene or script was discarded
scenes.dropped_other: {count} scenes without a scene or script were discarded

locks.title: Locks and gates
locks.empty: No locks set up: the screen shows no locks.
locks.missing: Lock or gate missing: will be discarded on save
locks.required: Required. Without a lock or gate, this item is discarded on save.
locks.dropped_one: {count} entry without a lock or gate was discarded
locks.dropped_other: {count} entries without a lock or gate were discarded

entityId.label: Lock, gate or sensor
entityId.help: A door or gate sensor only shows whether it's open or closed.

vacuums.title: Vacuums
vacuums.hint: The vacuum is enough: the integration finds the rest of the same device on its own (mode, suction, dock, maintenance, map…).
vacuums.empty: No vacuums: the screen doesn't show the Vacuums card.
vacuums.missing: Vacuum missing: will be discarded on save
vacuums.required: Required. Without a vacuum, this item is discarded on save.
vacuums.dropped_one: {count} entry without a vacuum was discarded
vacuums.dropped_other: {count} entries without a vacuum were discarded

name.label: Name
name.help: Empty uses the vacuum's name in Home Assistant.

cameras.title: Cameras
cameras.missing: Camera missing: will be discarded on save
cameras.required: Required. Without a camera, this item is discarded on save.
cameras.dropped_one: {count} entry without a camera was discarded
cameras.dropped_other: {count} entries without a camera were discarded

energy_flow.title: Energy flow
energy_flow.adv_note: The flow ignores values below these limits, so it doesn't flicker with sensor noise. Default: 10 W.

homePowerEntityId.label: House consumption
homePowerEntityId.help: Always positive. Split across the sources in the middle of the card.

tariffEntityId.label: Tariff
tariffEntityId.help: The current period (e.g. off-peak, peak) in the energy dialog.

consumers.title: Consumers
consumers.hint: Up to 4 appliances around the house on the Energy card.
consumers.empty: No consumers: the card shows only the sources and the house.
consumers.missing: Power sensor missing: will be discarded on save
consumers.required: Required. Without a power sensor, this item is discarded on save.
consumers.dropped_one: {count} consumer without a power sensor was discarded
consumers.dropped_other: {count} consumers without a power sensor were discarded
consumers.boiler_help_own: The Hot water card uses the entities from House › Alarm and hot water.
consumers.boiler_help_shared: Also feeds the Hot water card, which has no entities of its own.

lists.title: Lists
lists.hint: The Home Assistant to-do lists that show on the Lists page. The shopping list is the one with the cart icon.
lists.empty: No lists: the Lists page stays empty.
lists.missing: List missing: will be discarded on save
lists.required: Required. Without a list, this item is discarded on save.
lists.dropped_one: {count} entry without a list was discarded
lists.dropped_other: {count} entries without a list were discarded

cars.title: Cars
cars.hint: The screen shows up to 2 cars: the first ones on this list that are at home. Each car's “At home” entity decides.
cars.empty: No cars set up: the screen shows no cars.
cars.missing: Name missing: will be discarded on save
cars.required: Required. Without a name, this item is discarded on save.
cars.dropped_one: {count} car without a name was discarded
cars.dropped_other: {count} cars without a name were discarded

homeEntityId.label: At home
homeEntityId.help: When this entity says the car is at home, the card shows. Empty: always shows.

lockEntityId.label: Locked
lockEntityId.help: Shows whether the car is locked or unlocked.

chargeLimitEntityId.label: Charge limit
chargeLimitEntityId.help: The mark on the battery bar.

leave.title: Leave without saving?
leave.text: There are unsaved changes in {sections}. If you leave now, they're lost.
